title: Finite categorical Cech exactness implies vanishing of positive derived basis sections
statement: Let (C,J), A and B have the finite covering basis hypotheses of [stage3-categorical-finite-cover-local-zero], and assume injective resolutions for A-valued sheaves [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. If the categorical finite Cech complex of a sheaf F is exact in every positive degree on every finite B-cover of every B-object, then the (q+1)-st right derived evaluation of F at V is zero for every q≥0 and every V satisfying B. The property finiteCechAcyclicOn in Lean is exactly this positive Cech exactness, with all nerve terms required to satisfy B.

proof.text: An injective sheaf has injective underlying presheaf because sheafification is exact. Apply categorical injective-presheaf Cech exactness to see that every injective sheaf satisfies finiteCechAcyclicOn.

For a short exact sequence with Cech-acyclic kernel, quotient evaluation on every B-object is epic by the section-epimorphism theorem. Evaluation is already left exact. Finite products thus give a short exact sequence of Cech complexes for each finite B-cover. Detect diagram exactness using the existing upstream ShortComplex.exact_iff_evaluation, with a proof-only import.

The homology exact sequence shows that if the first two sheaves are positive Cech-exact, then the third is too: its degree k+1 homology lies between zero homology in degree k+1 of the second and degree k+2 of the first.
Apply the generic right-acyclicity criterion to evaluation and the property finiteCechAcyclicOn. It yields vanishing of every positive right derived evaluation.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 21.10.9, categorical finite-product dimension shifting; pointwise exactness is supplied by the existing upstream ShortComplex.exact_iff_evaluation.

lean.statement:
theorem isZero_rightDerived_eval_of_finiteCech
    [HasInjectiveResolutions (Sheaf J A)]
    (B : C → Prop)
    (hcov : ∀ V, B V → ∀ R ∈ J V, ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → Over V),
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n), B (Presheaf.cechNerveObj U y).left) ∧
      (∀ a, R (U a).hom) ∧
      Sieve.ofArrows (fun a ↦ (U a).left) (fun a ↦ (U a).hom) ∈ J V)
    (F : Sheaf J A) (hF : finiteCechAcyclicOn B F)
    (V : C) (hV : B V) (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (((sheafToPresheaf J A ⋙ (evaluation Cᵒᵖ A).obj (op V)).rightDerived
      (q + 1)).obj F)
